II, 6</cite> <he>לעשות שדהו מ׳ מ׳</he> to divide his field in straight lines (beds) of various seeds (instead of squares, <cite ref="M02570"><he>מרובע</he></cite>). Y. ib. II, 28ᵃ top. Y. Erub. IV, 21ᵈ bot. a telescope (v. <cite ref="M02293"><he>מְצוֹפוֹת</he></cite>) <he>שהיה משער בה עיניו במ׳</he> the horizontal range of which he had tested before (v. Bab.
<cite ref="Eruvin 43b">Erub. 43ᵇ</cite>).—Y. ib. V, 22ᵈ top [read:] <he>מביא מצופות ומשער … במ׳ וכ׳</he> he takes a telescope and tests its horizontal range, and then &c.
